sentences.text: Coram:
Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Sudhir Kumar Jain

Order
% 29.05.2024 CM APPL. 33110/2024 (for condonation of delay of 69 days)
1. The present application is filed under section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963 for condonation of delay of 69 days in filing the appeal.
2. In view of the reasons mentioned in the application, the delay of 69 days in filing the present appeal is condoned.
3. The application stands disposed of.
4. The present appeal is filed under section 54 of the Land Acquisition This is a digitally signed order.

ADJ-01+MACT, North-West District, Rohini Courts, Delhi in LAC bearing no. 407/2016 titled as Jagdev (Decd.) Through LRs & Ors. V UOI & Anr. seeking further enhancement in compensation amount and modification to the extent thereof in the impugned judgment arising out of the award bearing no. 16/2005-06/DC(N-W) pertaining to village Mubarakpur Dabas.
5. Issue notice.

6. Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, Standing Counsel appearing for respondent no. 1/Union of India,
accepts notice.

Ms. Mrinalini Sen, Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no.
2/DDA, accepts notice.

7. The counsel for the appellant stated that the connected appeal bearing LA APP. no. 645/2023 titled as Savitri Devi (Deceased) Thr. LRs V Union of India pertaining to the same village and award has already been admitted and the same is ordered to be listed in the category of 'Regular Matters'.
